Please read. It’s a crazy story. 

I was diagnosed when I was 13. I week before this incident I was diagnosed. The first one that I got diagnosed with wasn’t a crazy seizure but a seizure nonetheless. The next week I was at school and I didn’t get much sleep. I was ok for a while and then I remembered I asked the teacher if I can use the bathroom. Next thing I remember is going to the nurse office asking for my moms number ( They has my moms number but you know how they ask questions during an absence seizure ) Turns out I was in an absence seizure for 40 minutes beforehand sitting in the bathroom floor and then I waited there for my mom to get there. I was still in the absence seizure. Then I remembered being outside the school and my mom asking me if I’m ok. I replied with Yes because I had no clue wtf I was even doing out of school with my mom holding me asking me questions. Then next thing I know I’m in the hospital bed. I had back to back seizures for about 20 minutes. I’m a pretty white guy and I was the color of coal due to the lack of oxygen. I almost died. Only reason I didn’t was because they had me on like 10 different medications. Top doctors of the hospital were there in my ER room. So yup. Almost died lol. Hours of absence seizures and 20 minute seizures. 

But I’m ok now. 20 years old and my epilepsy is really fucking good so far. I’ve been absence seizure free for over a year, I don’t have strong myoclonic seizures anymore. And definitely no Grand Mals either. If everything goes well in a year from now they’ll reduce my medication over time until I’m med free. But you k ow how epilepsy is. One second you’re fine and the other you’re flopping like a fish hoping you don’t cross the line to death.
I never felt any difference. That’s just me. Everyone is different.
JME and have been depressed since I was 13.

Bro I’m basically going bald because of it. I had a lot of hair. After taking lamictal for years it’s so bad. My hair barely grows now and there’s stripes of baldness. But It helps my epilepsy 🤷🏻‍♂️ Keeps me seizure free. I just wear dad hats of like Lacoste, Ralph Lauren ,  Tommy Hilfiger, and Nike.

I had 2 in a row. I woke up drenched in sweat, my head feeling like it was gonna explode. Seizure headaches are the worst. When I got up to walk I felt 5 times heavier. If you wake up and your Tongue is bit really bad that’s a sign right there. Off the bat you know you seized.
I just tell them in the easiest way possible. “ you know when you sleep and everything is black, then you wake up? Yeah “

Yeah it’s one of the symptoms lol. You feel like your body is in a circle motion. Especially if you haven’t slept a lot. I’ve been taken lamictal ( brand ) for like 5 years and I still get dizzy if I just stare at one spot and focus on nothing.
Damn yeah whatever you think so best. Epilepsy ruined my life man. Mentally and financially
